items.prompt: I was walking home, but I stopped ____ some bread at the bakery.
items.translation_tr: Eve yürüyordum ama fırından ekmek almak için durdum.
items.hint: Did I stop the walk to do something else, or did I quit buying bread forever?
items.explain: 'Stop + to-infinitive' means you interrupt an action to do something else.

items.prompt: I clearly remember ____ the door. I am sure it is locked.
items.translation_tr: Kapıyı kilitlediğimi açıkça hatırlıyorum. Kilitli olduğuna eminim.
items.hint: Is this a memory of the past or a task for the future?
items.explain: 'Remember + gerund (-ing)' is used for memories of past actions.

items.prompt: Oh no! I forgot ____ the oven. I must go back home!
items.translation_tr: Ah hayır! Fırını kapatmayı unuttum. Eve geri dönmeliyim!
items.hint: Did I fail to do a task?
items.explain: 'Forget + to-infinitive' means you didn't do something you were supposed to do.

items.prompt: If you have a headache, try ____ an aspirin. It might help.
items.translation_tr: Başın ağrıyorsa bir aspirin almayı dene. Faydalı olabilir.
items.hint: Is this an experiment/suggestion or a difficult effort?
items.explain: 'Try + gerund (-ing)' means to do something as an experiment to see if it works.

items.prompt: He stopped ____ years ago. He is much healthier now.
items.translation_tr: Yıllar önce sigarayı bıraktı. Şimdi çok daha sağlıklı.
items.explain: 'Stop + gerund' means to quit a habit or a continuous action.

items.prompt: Please remember ____ your umbrella. It's going to rain.
items.translation_tr: Lütfen şemsiyeni almayı unutma. Yağmur yağacak.
items.hint: Don't forget to do this task in the future.
items.explain: 'Remember + to-infinitive' means to not forget to do a required task.

items.prompt: I'll never forget ____ the Dalai Lama in person. It was amazing.
items.translation_tr: Dalai Lama ile yüz yüze tanışmayı asla unutmayacağım. Harikaydı.
items.hint: This is a memory of a past event.
items.explain: We use 'forget + gerund' (usually in negative) for vivid memories of the past.

items.prompt: I tried ____ (lift) the heavy table, but I wasn't strong enough.
items.translation_tr: Ağır masayı kaldırmayı denedim ama yeterince güçlü değildim.
items.explain: 'Try + to-infinitive' means to make an effort to do something difficult.

items.prompt: She stopped ____ (talk) when the movie started.
items.explain: She ended the action of talking.

items.prompt: Did you remember ____ (call) your mother on her birthday?
items.translation_tr: Anneni doğum gününde aramayı hatırladın mı?
items.explain: A question about whether a task was remembered and performed.
Structure: Subject + forgot + to-infinitive (failure to perform a task).
Structure: He interrupted his journey (stopped) in order to check the map.
